purpose: Teach: 打ち切り/有価/作り上げる/使い捨て/版元/レスポンス/率先/囲む

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 赤字商品の打ち切りを進めましょう
lines.en: Let's move forward with discontinuing the low-margin products.
lines.style: Clear, purposeful opening. Business-like pace. Confident but not commanding. Weight on the decision itself, not on personal authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。有価証券報告書を準備します
lines.en: Got it. I'll get the securities report ready.
lines.style: Prompt, attentive. Quick intake breath before speaking. Nods in the voice. Earnest without being servile — showing he's tracking.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: チームで新しい企画を作り上げる時期ですね
lines.en: This is the moment for our team to build something new together.
lines.style: Invitational, almost warm beneath the professional tone. Slight lift on 'together' — signaling inclusion. Measured pace, like she's choosing the words carefully.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内の使い捨て備品を減らします
lines.en: Understood. I'll reduce the amount of disposable supplies we keep in stock.
lines.style: Responsive, matter-of-fact. No hesitation. The tone of someone taking notes mentally and already moving to the next task.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 版元との打ち合わせを設定しましょう
lines.en: Let's set up a meeting with the publisher.
lines.style: Directive but not harsh. Even rhythm. A checkpoint moment — pauses slightly after 'publisher' like it's a turning point in the plan.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。顧客アンケートのレスポンスを集計します
lines.en: Yes. I'll compile the customer survey responses.
lines.style: Steady follow-through. Professional shorthand in the delivery. Quick, efficient — showing mastery of his role without elaborating.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 率先して新システム導入を進めましょう
lines.en: Let's take the initiative and roll out the new system.
lines.style: Energized but controlled. Forward momentum in the phrasing. Slight emphasis on 'initiative' — encouraging, not demanding. Builds toward the statement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。会議室をパーティションで囲む案を出します
lines.en: Yes. I'll draft a proposal for partitioning off the meeting room.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Steady, assured. Slight settling in the tone — the sense of completing a full cycle. No trailing energy, but not abrupt.
